chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding
a woman who deflowered a slave girl by her hand. He (peace be upon him) said: Upon her is her dower, and she would be whipped eighty lashes.
ai.seo_question: What is the legal ruling and punishment for a woman who deflowers a slave girl?
ai.summary: In this ruling from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes that a woman who manually deflowers a young slave girl incurs both a financial penalty of the slave's mahr and a corporal punishment of eighty lashes, mirroring the standard hudud for fornication. This highlights the application of gender-neutral legal principles in Shia jurisprudence, where the mode of penetration (manual vs. vaginal) determines the specific compensation and punishment structure. The ruling underscores the value placed on the virginity of the slave girl as a distinct legal interest requiring restitution.
